_comment: Corroboration sources for Leon Coe's Knowledge Graph tracker. Update known_urls and action_guidance here — no code changes needed.

sources.label: LinkedIn Profile
sources.action_if_gap: Ensure LinkedIn profile is complete with current title, company, and summary.

sources.label: Crunchbase Profile
sources.action_if_gap: Create or complete Crunchbase profile at crunchbase.com/person/leon-coe

sources.label: Wikidata
sources.action_if_gap: Submit a Wikidata entry for Leon Coe. Include sameAs links to LinkedIn, Crunchbase, and website. This is the single highest-ROI KG action.

sources.label: Google Scholar / Academia
sources.action_if_gap: Publish a citable piece (white paper, research note) and submit to Academia.edu or SSRN.

sources.label: Houston Business Journal
sources.action_if_gap: Pitch a byline or contribute a quote to an HBJ reporter covering AI in Houston.

sources.label: InnovationMap
sources.action_if_gap: Pitch InnovationMap for a profile, op-ed, or event mention.

sources.label: Speaking Bio Pages
sources.action_if_gap: Speak at a Houston-area event and ensure the event page lists a full bio with title and company.

sources.label: Podcast Guest Appearances
sources.action_if_gap: Guest on a Houston business or AI podcast. Target shows with > 1k listeners.

sources.label: University / Org Affiliation Pages
sources.action_if_gap: Formalize an affiliation with Rice, UH, or TMC as an advisor, instructor, or fellow.
